record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, reduce each Transformer block’s feed-forward intermediate width from 2*hidden_units to hidden_units, retaining GELU and both pre-norm bidirectional attention blocks. Since widening regressed, a narrower feed-forward path may reduce overfitting on short histories and lower computation. Preserve features, embedding parameterization, residual paths, sequence selection, masked-target loss, appended-mask readout and optimizer. Keep one independently trained checkpoint per category and ensure the predictor writer reconstructs the same narrower architecture.
